claim: Humans are generally far from the battle scene.
originalWording: Humans are generally far from the battle scene.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Warfare generally places human participants far from the physical fighting, not merely some pilots.
reference.rationale: Large troop deployments and ground combat in 2009 contradict the general-removal claim. Ongoing front-line fighting and 2025 casualties in Ukraine contradict general removal today. Drones reduce some exposure without removing humans from war.

evidence.title: Excerpts of the President’s address to the nation
evidence.note: Describes active human fighting and plans for 30,000 additional US troops in Afghanistan in early 2010. Do not date those additional deployments to 2009..
